description_en: Renews plan subscriptions and purchases add-on packages for IoT cards. This operation applies only to single-card plans and same-tier pool plans. For unified-payment pool plans, use the pool expansion and feature fee purchase functions in the console
description_zh: 卡的套餐续订和叠加包订购，仅适用于单卡套餐和同档位池套餐（统付池套餐请通过控制台进行扩池和购功能费）
name: Renew

parameters.help_en:
The ICCID of the IoT card.

You can find the ICCID on the IoT card itself, or on the Card Management page of the IoT SIM Service console
parameters.help_zh:
物联网卡的ICCID。

您可在物联网卡上查看ICCID，或者在物联网SIM服务控制台的卡管理页面，查看ICCID
parameters.name: iccid

parameters.help_en:
The recharge type. Valid values:

STANDARD: renews a plan subscription.
OVERLAY: purchases an add-on package
parameters.help_zh:
充值类型。

STANDARD：续订套餐。

OVERLAY ：订购叠加包
parameters.name: recharge_type

parameters.help_en:
The custom order number. The number must be unique and idempotent.

If your recharge involves order management on your own platform, such as recharging for downstream customers, you can enter an external order number generated by your platform. After this operation is called successfully, an order number (OrderNo) is generated. This parameter helps you associate the generated order number with the external order number. If this scenario does not apply, enter any positive integer, such as 0
parameters.help_zh:
自定义的订单编号，编号需唯一且保持幂等性。

如果您的充值，涉及自有平台的订单管理，如给下游客户充值等，您可填入自有平台已生成的外部订单编号，该接口调用成功后，会生成一个订单编号（OrderNo）。该参数可以方便您将生成的订单编号与外部订单号关联起来。如果非此场景，你可填入任意正整数，例如0
parameters.name: serial_no

parameters.help_en:
This parameter is required when the recharge type is set to add-on package purchase.

Contact your technical support representative for the specific code
parameters.help_zh:
充值类型为订购叠加包时需填写。

具体Code请咨询技术对接人员
parameters.name: offer_code

parameters.help_en:
The number of units to purchase. Select the number based on the plan type of the IoT card. Valid values:
Renew a monthly plan: 1, 2, 3, 6, 9, or 12.
Renew an annual plan: 1, 2, or 3.
Purchase an add-on package: 1, 2, or 3
parameters.help_zh:
订购份数。根据物联网卡本身的套餐类型选择订购份数。
续订月套餐：支持1、2、3、6、9、12。

续订年套餐：支持1、2、3。

订购叠加包：支持1、2、3
parameters.name: buy_num

Code.description_en:
The response code.

200: success.
Other values: error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/375339.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码。

200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/375339.html）

OrderNo.description_en: The order number generated after the operation is called successfully
OrderNo.description_zh: 接口调用成功后生成的订单编号

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

LocalizedMessage.description_en: The error message displayed in the language that corresponds to the current region
LocalizedMessage.description_zh: 根据当前所在地展示对应语言的错误提示

RequestId.description_en: The request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，阿里云为该请求生成的标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful.
true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
